name: Honoring God
overview: Scripture calls believers to honor God through wholehearted love, faithful obedience, and reverent worship. Loving the Lord with all heart, soul, and might (Deuteronomy 6:5) involves choosing to serve Him above all else (Joshua 24:15) and fulfilling vows made to Him without breaking one's word (Numbers 30:2). Honoring God also extends to respecting His design in relationships, such as honoring parents (Exodus 20:12), offering the firstfruits of one’s increase (Proverbs 3:9), and showing mercy to the poor as a reflection of honoring the Creator (Proverbs 14:31). Together, these verses reveal that honoring God encompasses both devotion to Him and righteous conduct toward others.
